description: This header file provides utility functions for DirectX and Windows app development, including error handling, asynchronous data reading, pixel conversion, and SDK layer support checking.

methods.name: ThrowIfFailed
methods.description: Checks HRESULT and throws an exception if the call failed.

methods.name: ReadDataAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously reads binary data from a specified file.

methods.name: ConvertDipsToPixels
methods.description: Converts device-independent pixels (DIPs) to physical pixels based on DPI.

methods.name: SdkLayersAvailable
methods.description: Checks if SDK layers are available for debugging Direct3D applications.
